image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a turtle resting on mossy ground. The turtle has a high-domed, olive-green to brownish carapace with visible scute seams and some algae or texture. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout, small lateral eye, and striped neck pattern (yellow/orange stripes). One forelimb is visible, appearing stout with dark scales and claws. The background is blurred vegetation.

It appears smoother in terms of ridges, suggesting an adult or a different species variant, but strictly speaking, the specific 'three keels' feature is not clearly present.
